subject: Executive signoff and evidence package for capacity top-up

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: immediate 30% capacity top-up + retro billing carve

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the productive call this morning. As discussed, we have a spike in inference volume for a pilot clinical release and need a 30% capacity top-up effective October 15 so pipelines don't throttle. We understand commercial terms will be retroactive for October usage.

Two asks to move quickly:
- Can Redwood provide an evidence package (audit logs, token-level usage for Oct 15–31) for our procurement and security teams?
- We need an internal exec signoff confirming no SLA change; our legal wants a short memo confirming scope of the top-up and liability carveouts for retroactive billing.

I can approve on my side once Redwood's legal gives a short redline-free amendment and the evidence package is uploaded. We're hoping to close by next week (11/10).

Best,
Maya

--
Maya Singh
Head of Cloud Ops, Acme Health
maya@acmehealth.com

Maya — thanks, and appreciate the clear asks. Quick path forward from our side:

1) I'll put together the evidence package (logs + token-level breakdown) and upload to the shared Drive by EOD Thursday.
2) Kar (cc'd) will coordinate with Legal on a one-page amendment that: adds the 30% top-up, sets effective date to 2026-10-15, and includes a retroactive invoice for Oct usage.
3) We will also prepare a short executive memo for your approvers summarizing liabilities and any carveouts.

Hi all — legal here. Attached is redline_v3.docx (draft amendment) and an evidence checklist for the procurement team. Key points in draft:
- Exhibit A (Order Form): add line item for +30% throughput, effective 2026-10-15.
- Billing: one-time retroactive invoice for Oct 15–31, at the agreed committed rate.
- Liability: explicit statement that existing MSA indemnities remain unchanged; this amendment does not expand Redwood's liability beyond MSA.
- Termination: temporary pilot clause clarifying that top-up may be reversed if usage drops below threshold for 30 days (ops to confirm).

Open items we want Acme to confirm:
1) Acceptable invoice recipient and PO number for retro billing.
2) Ops confirmation of the 30% threshold rollback clause.

I marked small suggested tweaks in the doc — they are intended to be narrow. If Acme Legal pushes broader MSA edits, this will need leadership review.

Laura

Maya — following up with confirmed deliverables and next steps: attached are the evidence package (acme_evidence_package.zip), our redline (redline_v3.docx), and an executive memo for approvers (exec_signoff_memo.pdf). Summary:

- Scope: 30% throughput top-up added to your Order Form, effective 2026-10-15.
- Billing: single retroactive invoice for Oct 15–31 at committed rates; PO/AR instructions needed to finalize.
- Liability & SLA: amendment does not change MSA liability or SLAs.
- Rollback: provision for reversal if sustained usage drop below agreed threshold for 30 consecutive days — ops to confirm specific threshold.

Requested from Acme:
1) Confirm PO number and invoice recipient so we can issue the retro invoice.
2) Ops: confirm acceptable rollback threshold value; if none received, default threshold will be 40% of pilot baseline.

If Acme Legal is good with redline_v3 and your approver signs the memo, we can countersign and issue the invoice same day.

Thanks for the quick cycle — happy to jump on a call if that helps.

Best,
